name: dev-memory-supersede-tombstone
title: Honor dev-memory supersession at retrieval so a corrected lesson cannot resurface alone
description: The dev-memory ledger is append-only with no update, supersede or withdraw command, so correcting a wrong lesson means appending a new entry and hoping the reader arrives via a tag. Relevance-ranked retrieval can surface the superseded entry alone, with its false content and no successor. B-9ff1 is the empirical case: a three-iteration correction chain (a67bb17 -> 8d1d2bb -> e367ec1) whose first two entries remain retrievable while asserting claims three reviewer lanes established as false.
source: B-9ff1:F-068 (concept lane declined to pass and recommended this story by name); corroborated by B-9ff1:F-067 and B-9ff1:F-069
